calibration: Per-asset STAC stored_value * scale + offset, applied once before indices
sampling: At most one acquisition per third of month; lowest tile cloud cover within each third
unit: 100 m analysis cells, not farm boundaries
limitations: Single static crop reference; historical land use and rotation unverified
Sparse within-month sampling; not all archive images processed
Quality thresholds are demonstration settings, not validated thresholds
Grid cells can mix several fields; pixels and months are not independent labels
No measured degradation, soil salinity or yield outcomes
Missing values are missing observations, not evidence of degradation
